content.text: Almost. Health Canada's guidance is to start solids around 6 months, and Theo is 5 months, so the window opens in about a month. Look for signs he's ready: sitting up with little support, good head control, reaching for your food and opening his mouth for it. Until then, breast milk or formula is all he needs. Starting at 6 months is a guideline, so check timing with your provider too.
